text: Review each published alarm against its raw event history, affected equipment, onset, clearance and acknowledgement state. An acknowledgement records receipt and does not clear an active condition.
ko: 공개된 알람의 대상, 발생·복귀·인지 상태와 원시 이벤트를 확인한다.

text: Check the operating mode, procedure source and revision. Verify the time, quality and units of all required visible sensor readings before applying the procedure.

Record the possible causes and which clues are missing. Reactor temperature, pressure, level and cooling water outlet temperature do not distinguish a change in coolant inlet conditions from a flow or actuation problem. Inlet temperature and actual flow are not available in this base observation set.
ko: 가능한 원인과 판별에 부족한 단서를 구분한다. 기본 모드에 입구 온도·실제 작동 위치 또는 유량이 없어 냉각 관련 두 원인을 일의적으로 구별할 수 없다.

text: Record MONITOR under normal conditions. With sufficient evidence and no authorized intervention, retain the baseline or monitor. When a compatible document or necessary observations are missing, record abstention, the reason and the next check.
ko: 정상은 MONITOR, 근거가 있고 선택할 조치가 없으면 KEEP_BASELINE 또는 근거 있는 MONITOR, 문서·관측이 부족하면 이유와 다음 확인을 붙여 ABSTAIN을 기록한다.

text: Maintain baseline control and follow subsequent published observations until the actual episode termination can be verified.
ko: 기준 제어를 유지하면서 후속 출판 관측과 실제 종료를 확인한다.

text: Continuous measurements XMEAS(7), (8), (9), and (21) correspond to reactor pressure, level, temperature, and reactor cooling water outlet temperature.
ko: 반응기 압력·수위·온도 및 냉각수 출구 온도의 변수 정의.

text: Product separator temperature, level and pressure are measured in the vapor–liquid separation unit.
In the teaching simulation a sticking reactor cooling valve produces a cycling temperature trace. This simulated disturbance is an experiment, not an operator procedure.
ko: 냉각수 밸브 고착은 APMonitor 모사 실험의 한 사례다.

text: Loss of A feed in Case 8 changes material supply to the process. The teaching exercise monitors the response of the stripper inventory.
ko: 원료 A 공급 중단 교육 시나리오는 스트리퍼 재고 변화를 추적한다.

source.locator: A lost feed and the override (Case 8)
